# Old -> new commit map for the one history rewrite.
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
#
# Before its first push, this repository's history was rewritten once to remove
# apps/admin/src/test.md, which carried a credential. That changed every commit
# SHA after the first affected commit.
#
# WORK-LOG.md, HANDOFF.md, PLAN.md and the docs/phase-2 reports cite dozens of
# the OLD SHAs. Those documents are a record of what was decided and when, so
# they were deliberately NOT edited to match the new history — rewriting a
# record to agree with a rewritten past is how it stops being a record.
#
# This file is what keeps them resolvable. A SHA in the build record that git
# cannot find is an OLD one: look it up in the left column here to get the
# commit that exists today.
#
#   grep ^<old-sha> docs/commit-map.txt
#
# Short SHAs in the documents will not match directly; grep the prefix:
#
#   grep -i ^d376382 docs/commit-map.txt
#
# 141 commits, one line each, plus this header. A blank right-hand column would
# mean a commit the rewrite dropped entirely; there are none.
#
old                                      new
